name: Bauernhof Hauserhof
beschreibung: The farm estate Bauernhof Hauserhof is situated in Ebbs, Tyrol, and is classified as a traditional gasthof. The scenic property offers both self-catering holiday apartments and comfortable guest rooms. Fresh produce from the farm's own agriculture directly supplies the in-house kitchen, delivering exceptional culinary quality. The surrounding Alpine panorama is ideal for summer walking trails and winter skiing. Emphasising authentic farming practices, the hosts invite guests to observe everyday agricultural routines, making a stay here a wonderful combination of relaxing holiday and genuine country living.
